ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain School rules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Class Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain The school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
